newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HEINEKEN , PLANET HOLLYWOOD IN BEER LINK.
newsitem.headline: HEINEKEN , PLANET HOLLYWOOD IN BEER LINK.

text.p: Heineken has reached agreement to become the world-wide preferred beer supplier to all Planet Hollywood restaurants outside the U.S, the Dutch brewer said on Friday.

"Heineken and Planet Hollywood International, Inc. have decided to join forces. It is the first time in its 133-year history Heineken has completed a global on-premises deal," the company said in a statement.
"Due to the international and premium identity of both the Heineken and the Planet Hollywood brands, the arrangement is perceived by both companies as a natural partnership and a win-win situation."
The companies would jointly develop promotions in a number of selected markets, Heineken said. No further details of the agreement were given.

Planet Hollywood International, owner and franchiser of the movie-themed restaurants with integrated merchandise outlets, currently has 58 Planet Hollywood locations worldwide, of which 33 are outside the U.S. -- Amsterdam newsroom +31 20 504 5000, Fax +31 20 504 5040
